reason: Full-scope quality gates, safe test environment, missing tests and truthful result reporting.
Check default/home isolation, keyboard/touch controls, accessibility and component boundaries.
Check all RAF/timer/observer/listener/async cleanup and stale-response handling.
Verify SSR versus local state, viewer reset and no overwriting existing studio drafts.
Verify explicit permission flags and allowlisted client-bound data, not type casts or UI-only hiding.
Verify actual public DTO keys, preserved owner/admin access and existing streamed notFound semantics without UI-only privacy claims.
Review concrete homepage isolation, paging/clipboard/lifecycle contracts and honest asset/long-URL acceptance limits.
Ensure production fixtures/helpers do not cross server/client or task ownership boundaries.
Compatibility only: saved canvas preference and no automatic node/import/run behavior; preserve parallel mobile changes.
Do not validate through live credentials, relax wrappers, or clean shared infrastructure.
Check reuse and consistency of image, permission, navigation and constants.
Check actual source-to-DTO-to-client data and actions, including raw privacy payloads.
Verify reference fidelity and only the explicitly approved visual/business deviations.
Review guest/owner/public matrices, no clone/auto-run/auth-continuation and original privacy risks.
Check real replacement imagery, local font glyph coverage, licenses and no original broken images.
Acceptance matrix, actual async-page props/RSC evidence and limits of synthetic browser checks.
